overview: The Shadow Anomaly Expanse is the epicenter of shadow bleed-through in the Umbral Plains, where anomalies overlap and reality frays.
history: Initial planar fractures created isolated anomalies that slowly expanded.
Over time, multiple anomalies merged, forming a continuous Expanse.
Umbral Vanguard attempts to map and contain the Expanse have repeatedly failed.
Akhevan ritualists use the Expanse as a testing ground for shadow experiments.
hooks: A new mega-anomaly forms, altering travel routes.
Temporal fractures cause events to repeat or invert.
Akhevan ritualists lose control of a shadow experiment.
Umbral Vanguard scouts vanish inside a distortion field.
